contexts.text: Such are received as citizens everywhere in the earth, as they are also in the other life.
This life causes a man to be a citizen of the world; the former, a citizen of Heaven.
Through this good, and according to it, is man a citizen in the Spiritual World.

The difference is that the latter is not only a good citizen of an earthly kingdom, but is also a good citizen of the heavenly kingdom; whereas the former is a good citizen of an earthly kingdom, but not of the heavenly kingdom.
